business_problem: By opening up one-on-one tutoring to reach a broader marketplace, the company promotes an equitable and inclusive solution to the need for high-quality individual mathematics instruction.
solution_summary: , which provides remote one-on-one mathematics tutoring to schools across the United Kingdom and the United States, needed a cost-effective audio layer for its solution that was reliable, always available, and had good connectivity. The company was cloud based at its inception and had been using Amazon Web Services (AWS) for portions of its infrastructure. To solve for scalability and connectivity for the audio portion of its solution, Third Space Learning chose Amazon Chime , a communications service used to meet, chat, and place business calls inside and outside an organization, all using a single application. By migrating its audio to Amazon Chime, Third Space Learning has increased scalability, achieved high availability, and reduced in-session audio issues by 50 percent.

data_flow: Because the client-side data the company ingests from Amazon Chime is more in depth than what it gathered from its previous, self-hosted solution, Third Space Learning can more quickly identify the cause of connectivity issues.
business_outcome: Now, in the second half of 2023, Third Space Learning is in the process of migrating its monolithic application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), a managed Kubernetes service used to run Kubernetes on AWS, to further improve the scalability of its solution.
metrics: By migrating its audio to Amazon Chime, Third Space Learning has increased scalability, achieved high availability, and reduced in-session audio issues by 50 percent.
The company is democratizing tutoring by making it more financially accessible and works with over 3,800 schools and over 150,000 students, providing tens of thousands of sessions per week.
This migration occurred alongside the company rolling out a new virtual classroom, a process that took 18 months.

“It has been a positive experience virtually from start to finish.” Overall, the company experienced a 50 percent reduction in reported audio issues during sessions throughout the spring term of 2023.
Scalability is important for the company as it has begun to expand its offerings to the United States and provide 24-hour tutoring services across multiple time zones.
evidence_quotes: Third Space Learning connects primary and secondary schools in the United Kingdom and the United States with tutors across Sri Lanka and India to provide mathematics tutoring for its students and to improve student outcomes.
The company is democratizing tutoring by making it more financially accessible and works with over 3,800 schools and over 150,000 students, providing tens of thousands of sessions per week.
By opening up one-on-one tutoring to reach a broader marketplace, the company promotes an equitable and inclusive solution to the need for high-quality individual mathematics instruction.
Founded in 2013, Third Space Learning has been using AWS since its beginnings.

It started out with its monolithic application deployed on a single instance in Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), which offers secure and resizable compute capacity for virtually any workload.
